title: Stoneglove
summary: Stoneglove is a spell that coats the caster's hand in a rock-like casing. As such, this spell can be used to amplify a punch or to protect the caster's hand. When manifested, this spell emits a green aura.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Outside the sunken city of Atlantis, this spell was used by Dante Vale to rescue Cherit from a shark that attempted to eat the Titan by holding the shark's mouth open and then punching the shark. [Coming of Age]

During Sophie Casterwill's tests at the Fortress of Iron Will, Lok Lambert manifested Stoneglove with the intent of using it to prevent a Casterwill spike trap around a lever. [Sophie on Trial]

Dante Vale used Stoneglove alongside Doublespell to firmly grab the Betrayer, allowing Cherit to expose the Spiral symbol on his back and subsequently making it so Lok Lambert could strike it with the Willblade, finally defeating the Betrayer. [Dante's Return]
